title: Brackets
intro: Tournament brackets for the crew and the big screens: enter results here, or import them from a tournament tool's plugin. Winners move on by themselves.
name: Name
teamsHelp: One per line, best seed first. Byes fill up to 4, 8, 16 … teams.
publicOn: The public bracket view is on:
publicOff: The public bracket view is off. An admin turns it on in Settings > Attendee pages.
seatsHelp: Optional: the seats this match is played on, like A-1..A-5, B-1..B-5. They link to the floor plan.
clickHint: Click a match to enter scores, the winner, its seats and station.
